messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/2026.03.15 on cluster eu-west-1 (canary=5%). tagging: release/2026.03.15-canary :rocket:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: error-rate spike on /user/update (canary pool) — 5xx rate 18% (threshold 5%). Paging oncall team: @oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: I'm on it. looking at logs now. can someone share the canary change summary?
eng-miguel: The only DB change is migration 20260315_add_user_preferences: adds preferences JSONB not null. We put a backfill job but thought it would be async and non-blocking.
sre-anna: Logs show the api pods in canary failing with PG error: "column \"preferences\" does not exist" and some instances showing long schema-migration locks.
dbadmin-zoe: Uh — the migration we ran adds column without default and includes a heavy backfill update that touches users table. That backfill is running as part of deployment job and holding locks.
eng-sam: That backfill was meant to be a separate job, but our helm job container runs migration: "./manage migrate --apply --with-backfill" in the image. bad me.
pm-lee: Customers on canary are impacted. How bad is it? any external 5xx or failed requests?
sre-anna: External 5xx from canary router only so far, but if we don't act it will bleed to stable. Suggest kill flag for feature and pause rollout.
oncall-alex: Agree. Initiating rollback policy to stop canary progression. @deploy-bot can you stop further canary batches and pause rollout?
deploy-bot: Canary progression paused. No further canary batches will be promoted. Rollback not yet executed.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01. Severity: P1 (potential customer impact).
oncall-alex: @dbadmin-zoe can you see whether the migration job can be cancelled without leaving schema half-applied?
dbadmin-zoe: The migration has three steps: 1) ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN preferences JSONB; 2) backfill UPDATE users SET preferences = '{}' WHERE preferences IS NULL; 3) ALTER TABLE ALTER COLUMN preferences SET NOT NULL. The backfill is the long-running blocking update. If we cancel the job right now we risk the column existing with some rows null which is fine as long as the app tolerates null. But we currently saw app errors "column does not exist" on some canary pods which suggests race where app tries to read column before ALTER finished on some replicas.
eng-miguel: We changed the code to reference preferences in the request path. Old pods don't expect it so they error when queries include new column? Strange.
eng-sam: Confirmed: some canary instances were started before migration applied on DB nodes they hit, so queries referencing the new column fail.
sre-anna: Mitigation options: 1) Killfeature flag so code path in canary doesn't touch new column (if feature-flagged), 2) Rollback canary service to image before DB migration job started, 3) Cancel backfill and run non-locking backfill strategy (batch updates with primary key ranges).
pm-lee: Is there a kill-switch for the feature flag?
eng-miguel: Yes, feature flag key: ff.user_preferences.enable. Canary was supposed to be behind it but I guess toggled early. I'm toggling it off now.
eng-miguel: toggled ff.user_preferences.enable -> false :white_check_mark:
eng-sam: After flag toggle some errors dropped but DB backfill still holds locks causing slow requests and connection queueing.
oncall-alex: For safety, start rollback of canary pods to previous image. @deploy-bot start rollback to release/2026.03.14-canary-image.
deploy-bot: Starting rollback of canary pods. Expected completion in ~2 minutes.
incident-bot: Handoff: @oncall-alex -> @sre-anna for next 2 hours.
sre-anna: Taking over. I'll coordinate DB changes with @dbadmin-zoe.
dbadmin-zoe: Plan: cancel migration job to release locks, then add column without backfill (nullable), restart app fleet on stable image, then run an incremental backfill using small batches off-peak. Command to cancel job: `kubectl delete job user-migration-20260315 -n migrations`
eng-sam: Can you confirm cancellation safety? any risk of partial DDL?
dbadmin-zoe: ALTER ADD COLUMN is atomic on Postgres if it only adds a nullable column. The problem is the large UPDATE holding locks. Cancelling will leave column present or absent depending on step; I've checked migration logs: ALTER completed on all primaries, UPDATE is running. Cancelling will stop UPDATE. Column exists on primaries. Apps failing likely due to propagation timing.
sre-anna: Ok proceed to cancel migration. @eng-miguel coordinate app rollout freeze and ensure no new jobs start.
dbadmin-zoe: Executing: `kubectl delete job user-migration-20260315 -n migrations`
dbadmin-zoe: Command returned: job deleted. Backfill processes terminated. :white_check_mark:
sre-anna: Observing DB connections go down, lock count decreasing. Good.
eng-sam: Rolling back canary images completed. Canary pods now on previous image.
eng-miguel: We're seeing 5xx drop to normal. Confirming health checks are green.
pm-lee: Any customer-facing notes? Is data at risk?
dbadmin-zoe: No data loss. We have partial state: column exists but many rows are null. That's expected and safe. Plan is to run controlled backfill in batches: SQL snippet I'll run: ```sql
-- backfill in batches
UPDATE users SET preferences = '{}' WHERE preferences IS NULL AND id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
-- loop with small ranges and sleeps
```
eng-sam: Suggest adding low-priority background job that uses primary key pagination and LIMIT 1000 with short sleeps to avoid locks.
sre-anna: I'll open a follow-up change window for the backfill and schedule it for off-peak tonight. For the incident timeline, we're moving to mitigation/monitoring.
oncall-alex: Handoff complete. Alex signs off.
incident-bot: Updating INC-2026-0315-01 status -> mitigated. Impact: canary only, no customer data loss. Postmortem requested.
pm-lee: We should notify customers who hit errors during the window (15:03 - 15:18 UTC). I'll draft a message after we close the postmortem.
eng-miguel: Lessons: never run heavy backfills in migrate job, always keep DB DDL additive and nullable-only and feature-flag the code path. I'll submit a PR to change our deploy job template.
dbadmin-zoe: I'll document backfill tooling and safe migration checklist.
sre-anna: Closing thread to monitoring. Ping if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
